tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.beas.why: A 10-minute-or-longer post-fight harvest of a slain magical beast's core/gland/pearl, not an in-fight action.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.bitt.why: Advantage only against hazards caused by harvesting, including a Quick Field Harvest during combat. After a natural-1 poison or spore hazard, choose whether to pay 1 CP or Stamina to reduce its damage by PB plus your Gathering ability modifier. The table does not yet track this harvesting hazard.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.camp.why: A Long Rest wilderness-foraging benefit (food/fuel/water for the party).

HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_CLEAN_HARVEST.why: Normally a ten-minute harvest with appropriate tools. Quick Field Harvest permits an Action for Common material. The table still needs the real site, material, Harvest DC, available Lots and any hazard before it can resolve this.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.clea.why: A +2 bonus to a Clean Harvest check made with proper tools, outside any fight.
Purifies a contaminated harvested Lot; a crafting-time action, not a fight action.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.comm.why: Advantage to identify or harvest actual Common material. After Clean Harvest succeeds by 5 or more, you may take an extra Lot if material remains. The table does not yet track that site and extra Lot.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.dew_.why: Improves how long harvested liquids stay sealed; a storage/logistics benefit.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.dryi.why: Doubles Lots preserved during a Short Rest and slows storehouse spoilage; downtime logistics.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.farm.why: A 10-minute field inspection Gathering Check for crop/garden information.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.fiel.why: Record-keeping between sessions that grants Advantage on a later Read the Sign/Clean Harvest at a known site; not itself a fight action.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.firs.why: During a Short Rest, spend one Common medicinal Lot to treat up to PB creatures. Each gains Advantage on its first poison, disease or travel-Exhaustion save before its next Long Rest, once per Long Rest. That prepared benefit is not yet carried into fights automatically.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.fora.why: A Stealth/Survival proficiency plus an alternate approach check for reaching a guarded Resource Site; exploration, not combat.

HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_HARVEST_LOTS_A.why: Defines what a Harvest Lot is and its quality tiers; a crafting/inventory definition, not a fight mechanic.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.haza.why: Spend 1 CP or Stamina to choose Resistance to one hazard associated with the site until this harvest attempt ends. Unrelated combat damage does not qualify; the GM may allow a hazard inseparable from the fight. The table does not yet track that attempt and choice.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.hidd.why: A passive sense for spirit herbs/medicinal materials while exploring.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.ingr.why: Identifies a Harvest Lot's best use category (Alchemy, medicine, poison...); crafting/logistics.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.mark.why: A selling/trading Gathering Check for mundane produce; downtime economy, not combat.

HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_READ_THE_SIGN.why: Use Search or Study, or spend ten minutes examining a real Resource Site. The GM supplies its Gathering DC and facts; the table does not yet resolve that site examination automatically.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.root.why: Trades harvest yield to keep the source alive; a harvesting-time choice.

HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_SEAL_THE_ESSEN.why: Extends how long harvested Lots stay fresh; a Short Rest/10-minute preservation action.

tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.sect.why: Downtime supervision of a medicine field/herb garden/apiary between sessions.

HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_TRAINING_AND_T.why: Grants a tool/skill proficiency (and a bonus talent) when the sphere is learned; a one-time build grant, not a fight action.

tianxia.talent.alchemy.advanced_pill_for.why: Lets you craft Rare/Very Rare recipes and reroll a failed Alchemy Check during refinement; refinement happens between fights.

ALCHEMY_BASE_ALCHEMY_CHECK.why: The refinement/crafting check rolled when brewing a recipe (distinct from a technique's save DC); not rolled in a fight.

ALCHEMY_BASE_ALCHEMY_TRAINING.why: The one-time grant (tool proficiency + the sphere's other base abilities) received on learning Alchemy; not itself an action.

TAL_ALCHEMY_BATCH_REFINEMENT.why: Refines several doses of the same recipe at once; a refinement-time choice.

TAL_ALCHEMY_CLEAN_FURNACE_METHOD.why: A Short Rest cauldron-cleaning ritual that improves the next refinement check.

tianxia.talent.alchemy.eternal_pill_form.why: A multi-day, 2,500 gp Very Rare pill formula learned between sessions; refinement, not a fight action.

TAL_ALCHEMY_FALSE_MEDICINE_PILL.why: A crafted decoy pill for social deception; consuming it has no fight effect by design.

TAL_ALCHEMY_FASTING_PILL.why: Removes the need to eat/drink for 7 days; has no effect inside the timescale of a single fight.

TAL_ALCHEMY_FURNACE_MASTERY.why: A +2 bonus to Alchemy Checks made with a proper cauldron, and reduced improvised-cauldron penalty; refinement only.

tianxia.talent.alchemy.heaven_defying_pi.why: A 30-day, 10,000 gp Legendary refinement project (once per year); refinement, not a fight action.

TAL_ALCHEMY_INGREDIENT_SUBSTITUTION.why: Substitutes a refinement ingredient for another of equal value; refinement only.

tianxia.talent.alchemy.living_pill_spiri.why: Binds a 7-day companion spirit from a successful high-tier refinement; the binding happens outside a fight (the spirit's own combat-relevant Help action, if any, would need a summon record this talent does not grant).

tianxia.talent.alchemy.nine_revolution_r.why: A Disadvantage-for-better-odds refinement gambit; refinement only.

TAL_ALCHEMY_PILL_APPRAISAL.why: Advantage on Study checks to identify pills/elixirs/cauldrons; identification, not a fight action.

ALCHEMY_BASE_PILL_FORGING.why: The base crafting-reroll ability granted with the sphere (duplicate text of Advanced Pill Forging in the source material); refinement only.

tianxia.talent.alchemy.pill_spirit_creat.why: Attempts to awaken a Pill Spirit during refinement; a crafting-time roll.

TAL_ALCHEMY_RAPID_REFINEMENT.why: Speeds up refinement time for a Common/Uncommon recipe; refinement only.

ALCHEMY_BASE_REAGENT_STOCK.why: A fight starts with the uses prepared at the last Long Rest: Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier (minimum 1), spent by Field Formula and the other Alchemy costs (combat/ext/alchemy_stock.py, rider lane C10). The gold cost and spoiling are outside fights.

TAL_ALCHEMY_SEALED_DOSE_METHOD.why: Reagent Stock + Proficiency Bonus, and one sealed Medicinal Smoke an ally can administer as an Action (combat/ext/alchemy_stock.py, rider lane C10).

tianxia.talent.alchemy.spirit_gathering_.why: Consumed during a 10-minute cultivation meditation for CXP; not usable in a fight.

tianxia.talent.poison.cultivation_severi.why: A 10-minute ritual against a restrained/unconscious/willing/incapacitated target (or three successful Ingrain the Toxin uses over 24 hours); already routed as a procedure, not a combat action.

tianxia.talent.blood.blood_hound.why: A 10-minute ritual that studies a Blood Sample to track its source over the following 24 hours; not usable in a fight.

tianxia.talent.blood.bloodline_reading.why: A 10-minute ritual reading a body's inherited bloodline traits; not usable in a fight.

tianxia.talent.karma.break_the_crooked_o.why: Targets "one oath, contract, bargain, or supernatural obligation you can perceive" and reads/suppresses its penalties; the table has no oath/contract objects to target (the same gap as Chain the Door's bound-object DC, generalized to a narrative obligation instead of a physical one). The GM adjudicates its Karma Check and effect by hand.

tianxia.talent.life.break_enchantment.why: An augment to Purify the Pulse. Du Daoyuan reached Life through a single Path-granted talent pick, not the Life sphere itself, so Purify the Pulse (and the rest of the sphere's Pulse base kit) was never compiled for him; the augment has nothing to attach to.

tianxia.talent.life.clear_physician_s_ey.why: Lets Read the Pulse ask one extra GM-answered question; Read the Pulse was never compiled for Du Daoyuan (Life reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere), and the clause is a GM Q&A rather than a fight effect even where the base ability exists.

tianxia.talent.life.empathic_transfer.why: An augment to Purify the Pulse, which Lingyue Frostveil does not have compiled (Life reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere).

tianxia.talent.life.fount_of_life.why: Stores healing from Mend the Pulse (a Long-Rest-scale reserve) for later release; Mend the Pulse was never compiled for Lingyue Frostveil (Life reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere), and the storage mechanic itself spans rests rather than a single fight.

tianxia.talent.life.life_preserving_diag.why: Triggers when a creature bearing this character's Pulse Seal would die; Pulse Seal (and Read the Pulse, one of its three Reaction options) were never compiled for Lingyue Frostveil (Life reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere), so the trigger condition can never be met.

TAL_FLOWERS_BEGUILING_PERFUME.why: Affects "a creature that enters the Fragrance"; Fragrance-making is a Flowers base-sphere ability Lianhui of the Flowing Grave does not have (Flowers reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere), so there is never a Fragrance for this to trigger from.

TAL_FLOWERS_LAYERED_BOUQUET.why: Lets a second Fragrance talent apply to the same Fragrance; entirely dependent on the Fragrance-making base ability Lianhui of the Flowing Grave does not have (Flowers reached through a single talent pick, not the sphere).
